mechanics.name: Alert
mechanics.currentEffect: Whenever the Killer performs a Break or Damage Action, their Aura is revealed to you for 3/4/5 seconds.
activation: The Killer performs a Break or Damage Action.
Ends/deactivates when: Aura reveal ends after the tier duration.
mechanics.patchNote: Latest live balance change (2.3.0): Removed range and cooldown; reveal duration set to 3/4/5 seconds.
mechanics.plainEnglishSummary: Breaking or damaging something reveals the Killer's Aura briefly.
duration: Killer Aura reveal: 3/4/5 seconds by tier.

editorial.summary: Whenever the Killer breaks or damages something, see their Aura for up to 5 seconds, with no range or cooldown.
useCases: Identify the Killer's location and direction after pallet breaks, generator kicks, and other Break or Damage actions.
Use repeated Aura reads to decide whether to stay on a generator, rotate, rescue, or prepare for chase.
Learn how different Killers path after breaking resources, making the perk useful for developing game sense.
counters: Stealth or Aura-blocking effects can deny the information.
A Killer who performs few qualifying Break or Damage actions gives the perk fewer triggers.
Knowing the Killer's location does not itself create distance if your positioning is already poor.
pros: Patch 9.5.0 removed the old range and cooldown limitations.
Requires no setup and can trigger many times in a normal Trial.
Excellent Solo Q information that remains useful even without voice communication.
cons: Pure information perk with no direct chase speed, healing, or objective bonus.
Trigger frequency varies by Killer and playstyle.
Aura denial can shut down the perk at important moments.
analysis: Alert closes this band at this position because its current 9.5-era design is one of the cleanest information perks in the game. Whenever the Killer performs a qualifying Break or Damage action, their Aura is shown for up to five seconds, and the modern version no longer has the old range or cooldown restrictions.

That makes the perk useful in almost every phase of a Trial. A generator kick can tell you whether the Killer is turning toward your position. A pallet break reveals the direction they take after the animation. Repeated triggers also let Solo Q players infer where pressure is moving without needing teammates to communicate it.

Alert is especially valuable for learning. New and intermediate players can watch how Killers path after breaking pallets and understand when a chase is actually heading toward them. Experienced players use the same information more aggressively, deciding when to greed generator progress or rotate before the Killer can establish pressure.

It ranks below the more directly impactful perks because information only matters if the player acts on it. Alert does not save a health state, accelerate a generator, or shorten a heal by itself. But because it is passive, repeatable, and broadly applicable, it remains more dependable than narrower utility perks.
editorial.verdict: A superb low-maintenance information perk. Alert's current no-range, no-cooldown design gives Solo Q players repeated Killer-location reads without demanding any setup.
